visual.general_description: Scatter chart with two marker series and two straight linear trend lines across five time labels, with a legend and two printed regression equations.
visual.detailed_description: White-background chart with grey horizontal gridlines. The horizontal axis carries the five labels t0, t1, t2, t3 and t4; the vertical axis has no title and prints numeric tick labels from -0.2 to 1.4 in steps of 0.2. Blue diamond markers are the "Theta Cartoon" series and orange square markers are the "Theta Story" series, each with one marker per time label. A legend lists "Theta Cartoon", "Theta Story", "Linear (Theta Cartoon)" and "Linear (Theta Story)", the last two as thin dark line samples. Two straight dark trend lines both slope gently downward from left to right, one steeper than the other. Printed in the plot area are "y = -0.0249x + 0.4728" with "R² = 0.0072" and "y = -0.073x + 0.3425" with "R² = 0.1586". The Theta Story markers vary without a single monotone pattern across the time labels, as do the Theta Cartoon markers. No title, panel letters or patient identifiers are printed.

No title, panel letters or patient identifiers are printed.
